text: The Sun is the star at the center of the Solar System. Earth orbits the Sun.
Earth is the third planet from the Sun. It has one natural satellite, the Moon.
Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System. It is a gas giant.
Mars is often called the Red Planet because iron minerals on its surface give it a reddish appearance.
Water freezes at 0 degrees Celsius at standard atmospheric pressure.
The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth.
Photosynthesis allows plants and other organisms to convert light energy into chemical energy.
The human heart is a muscular organ that pumps blood through the circulatory system.
